name: Gateway 状态检查
executable_code:
#!/bin/bash
# Gateway 状态检查 Capsule
# 检查 Gateway 运行状态和认证配置

echo "🦞 OpenClaw Gateway 状态检查"
echo "=============================="
echo ""

echo "1️⃣ 检查 Gateway 服务状态..."
openclaw gateway status

echo ""
echo "2️⃣ 检查 Gateway 详细状态 (JSON)..."
openclaw gateway status --json | head -30

echo ""
echo "3️⃣ 检查认证配置..."
openclaw config get gateway.auth

echo ""
echo "4️⃣ 检查 Control UI 配置..."
openclaw config get gateway.controlUi

echo ""
echo "5️⃣ 检查端口监听..."
netstat -tlnp 2>/dev/null | grep 18789 || ss -tlnp | grep 18789

echo ""
echo "6️⃣ 配置验证..."
openclaw doctor
description: 检查 Gateway 运行状态和认证配置，包括服务状态、JSON 详情、认证配置、Control UI 配置、端口监听和配置验证
expected_output: Gateway 状态报告、认证配置、端口信息
error_handling: 如 Gateway 未运行，提示 'Runtime: not running'
